steps.action: Launch Android app, enter server URL and credentials

steps.action: Launch TV app, enter server URL and credentials using D-pad
steps.expected: Home screen with media carousel loads

steps.action: POST /api/v1/favorites with a media entity ID

steps.name: Verify on Web
steps.expected: Favorited entity appears in the list

steps.name: Verify on Android TV
steps.action: Navigate to favorites section on TV app

steps.name: Verify removal on API
steps.expected: Entity no longer in favorites list

steps.name: Verify on Web
steps.expected: All added items visible in collection

steps.name: Connect WebSocket on Web
steps.action: Open web app, verify WebSocket connected indicator

steps.name: Trigger scan via API
steps.action: POST /api/v1/scans to start storage root scan

steps.name: Verify WebSocket notification
steps.action: Check web app for real-time scan notification
steps.expected: Scan progress updates appear in real-time via WebSocket

steps.name: Start playback on Web
steps.action: Play a media item on web, pause at 50%

steps.name: Resume on Android TV
steps.action: Open same media item on TV app
steps.expected: Offers to resume from saved position (~50%)

steps.name: Login with new user via API

steps.expected: Returns at least one entity with id, name, type

steps.name: View entity on Web
steps.expected: Entity detail page shows same name, type, metadata as API

steps.name: View entity on Android TV
steps.action: Navigate to entity detail on TV app
steps.expected: Same entity info displayed, poster image loaded

steps.name: Search same term on Web
steps.expected: Same number of results as API, same entity names

steps.action: Login on both web browser and via API

steps.name: Verify API session invalidated

steps.name: Scan via API
steps.action: POST /api/v1/scans with the new root ID

steps.name: Browse entities on Web
steps.expected: Newly scanned entities appear in browse view

steps.name: Verify entity details
steps.expected: Entity detail page shows metadata, file associations

steps.name: Login from all platforms
steps.action: Login with same user on Web, API, and Android TV simultaneously

steps.name: Perform operations
steps.action: Add favorite on Web, search on API, browse on TV

steps.name: Verify consistency
steps.action: Check favorites list on all three platforms
steps.expected: All platforms show the newly added favorite

steps.action: Login as testuser on both web and API

steps.name: Admin locks user
steps.action: Admin locks testuser account via API

steps.name: Verify web session blocked
steps.action: Testuser tries to access a page on web

steps.name: Verify API session blocked
steps.action: Testuser tries API request with existing token

steps.name: Verify TV discovers service
steps.action: Open TV app server discovery screen
steps.expected: API server appears in discovered services list

challenges.name: Error Response Format Same on All Endpoints

steps.name: Trigger 401 error
steps.expected: JSON error with 'error' field, consistent format

steps.name: Trigger 404 error
steps.expected: JSON error with same format structure as 401

steps.name: Trigger 400 error
steps.expected: JSON error with same format structure

steps.name: Verify no stack traces
steps.expected: No internal paths, stack traces, or debug info in any error response
